test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lc_short_runs ( k UInt32, v UInt64, lc1 LowCardinality(String), lc2 LowCardinality(String), lc3 LowCardinality(String), lc4 LowCardinality(String), lc5 LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), m Map(LowCardinality(String), Int64) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lc_short_runs SELECT k, p * 1000000000 + number, concat('const-', toString(p % 2)), concat('key-', toString(k % 1000), repeat('x', k % 30)), concat('part-', toString(p)), concat('mod-', toString((k + number) % 50)), if(number % 4 = 0, NULL, concat('n-', toString(k % 11))), if(k % 3 = 0, map(), map(concat('mk-', toString(k % 17)), toInt64(number))) FROM ( SELECT p, k, number FROM (SELECT number AS p FROM numbers(20)) AS parts CROSS JOIN (SELECT toUInt32(number) AS k FROM numbers(50000)) AS keys ARRAY JOIN range(1 + (k * 7 + p) % 16) AS number ) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT k, lc1, lc2, lc3, lc4, lc5 FROM lc_short_runs ORDER BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, m FROM lc_short_runs ORDER BY k FORMAT Null
